title: Whispering Map
moral: True treasure is courage and protecting what matters.

story: Jamie discovers a magical treasure map in his grandmother’s shed and begins a journey across Willowbrook. As he follows clues through bridges and forests, he is chased by people who want the treasure. Using courage and intelligence, he reaches the hidden chamber and protects it. In the end, he learns that the real treasure is bravery and kindness.
